findings.text: the repair is written in a file outside the node's declared write paths, which named only reckon/crew/queue_edit.py and reckon/crew/runs.py, and the manifest's outside_scope line states nothing outside the declared scope was changed; queue_admission.py is the defect's real owner and the change is correct, but the coordinator should ratify the path rather than read the fence as proven.

the new _RederivationRefusedError path is unguarded by any test: no case makes _section_rederivation raise, so a regression that stops catching the exception (letting it abort the whole admission pass for every request) or that stops recording the refusal would pass all three cases.

the done_when's negative-control clause ('at the base revision the scope check names the added path as outside the declared write scope') cannot be met as written, because the launch path was already correct and this case passes at base; the run's negative control substitutes the held-release case, which is the actual mechanism, so the substitution should be recorded against the section rather than against the done_when.
